title: Capital Gains on Crypto
shortAnswer: Flat 30% tax on Virtual Digital Assets (VDA).
longAnswer: Virtual digital assets (crypto, NFTs, tokens) are taxed under Section 115BBH. Gains are taxed at a flat 30% with no deduction for expenses other than the cost of acquisition, and no set-off of losses against other income or against gains from other crypto assets. A 1% TDS under Section 194S applies on transfer, and the buyer deducts it. The holding period does not matter—there is no long-term or short-term distinction, so the 30% rate applies regardless of how long you held the asset. The calculator takes your sale value and cost of acquisition to show the taxable gain and the 30% liability, plus the 194S TDS. It does not account for the 1% TDS already deducted (which you claim as a credit when filing). Report crypto gains in Schedule VDA of the ITR. Verify the current rules on the e-filing portal, as the VDA regime is still evolving.
